name: society-mgmt-300k
description: Ajit-backprop-test - test project for backprop integration (synthetic society management codebase).

scripts.build: find src tests -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -r -n1 node --check && echo 'build: syntax check passed'
scripts.lint: find src tests -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -r -n1 node --check && echo 'lint: ok (node --check)'
scripts.test:unit: find tests/unit -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -r -n1 node && echo 'test:unit: all files executed'
scripts.test:integration: find tests/integration -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -r -n1 node && echo 'test:integration: all files executed'
scripts.migrate: if [ -z "$DB_HOST" ]; then echo 'migrate: DB_HOST is not set; cannot run database migrations' >&2; exit 1; else echo "migrate: would run migrations against $DB_HOST (no migration framework is present in this project)"; fi
scripts.start: echo 'No application entry point is defined for this project (no server/index.js).' >&2 && exit 1
